label: New Hampshire: applicability
note: Verified editorial summary, not a verbatim statutory extract. Primary text retrieved for the September 22, 2026 applicability candidate. Current applicability text fetched; no future amendment applied.
body: Does it conduct business in New Hampshire OR produce products or services targeted to New Hampshire residents?

During a one-year period, does it control or process personal data of at least 35,000 unique consumers (excluding payment-only data); OR at least 10,000 unique consumers AND derive strictly more than 25% of gross revenue from selling personal data?
Unique New Hampshire consumers acting in an individual/household context, excluding commercial and employment roles. Deduct payment-only data from the 35,000 limb.
Measuring period: During a one-year period. The statute does not call it the preceding calendar year.
